title: OP   Script  Aurorahud
features:
🛠️ AUTO BUILD & EXPAND Why click the buttons yourself when the script can build your entire tycoon in seconds?

Auto Buy Multipliers: Instantly purchase all available multipliers the second you can afford them.

Auto Buy Decor & Structures: Automatically fills out your plot so you don't have to walk around like an idiot.

Auto Buy Streams & Upgrades: Expands your revenue streams effortlessly.

Auto Buy Minigames: Unlocks all side content instantly.

Custom Purchase Speed: Adjust exactly how fast the script buys things (from 0.05s to 1s delays).

📈 AUTO UPGRADES Maximize your profits with zero micromanagement.

Upgrade Active Streams: Automatically funnels your cash into upgrading your current streams.

Auto Power Level: Keeps your overall power level climbing to maximize your lemon output.

Custom Upgrade Speed: Control the flow of upgrades so your game never lags out.

🍋 UTILITIES & GATHERING The bread and butter of your farming empire.

Auto Click Lemons (Ultra Fast): Bypasses standard limits to farm lemons at borderline game-breaking speeds.

Auto Collect Lemons: Standard safe collection for smooth, background AFK farming.

Auto Wake Streams: Choose between Normal or Fast waking so your workers are never slacking off.

Auto Trigger Prompts: Automatically interacts with any annoying in-game pop-ups so your AFK session never breaks.

⭐ PROGRESSION (RANK UP) Climb the leaderboards effortlessly while you sleep.

Auto Rebirth: Automatically resets your progress for permanent multipliers the moment you hit the threshold.

Auto Evolve: Automatically evolves your empire to the next tier.

Auto Ascend: Pushes you into the god-tiers of the game without you having to touch a thing.

🔥 EVENTS & MINIGAMES Fully automated support for active events and minigames so you never miss out on limited-time rewards!
